name: Amartya Sen
shortBio: Indian philosopher and Nobel laureate economist who pioneered social choice theory, the Capabilities Approach with Martha Nussbaum, and comparative anti-transcendental theories of justice rooted in Indian deliberative traditions.
centralQuestion: Why must justice evaluate real human capabilities and comparative reductions of manifest injustice rather than idealized transcendental institutions?

keyWorks.title: Development as Freedom
keyWorks.description: Articulates the Capabilities Approach, defining development as the expansion of substantive freedoms rather than income growth alone.

keyWorks.title: The Idea of Justice
keyWorks.description: Critiques Rawlsian transcendental institutionalism by synthesizing social choice theory with classical Indian niti-nyaya jurisprudence.
